description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) KAPTARIS ka'tah at the start of the OPPONENT's Fight phase through the real fight_phase_start window (WP-C3). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active: the Command-phase load readies the Custodes in their own turn; the scenario then jumps to the Orks' Fight phase of the same battle round (setup privilege: active player 2), where a unit that is STILL readied can use a Fight-phase ka'tah. The Shield-Captain is moved out of the fight so the Boyz' only target is the Custodian Guard. (1) Start of the Fight phase: the window opens for the Custodes with Dacatarai / Kaptaris KA'TAH cards; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard Sodality' (Kaptaris) spends no CP and un-readies the unit; the re-opened window (other readied units) is declined. (2) Pile-ins end. (3) The Orks (active player, selects first) click the Boyz to fight; their attacks against the Custodian Guard roll at -1 to hit, named 'Kaptaris (Ka'tah)' in the hit roll's modifier ledger (the resolution dock's provenance line). Setup privileges: CP 0 for both players (no paid stratagem prompts), auto wound allocation.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description): the Shield-Captain steps out of the fight, CP 0, auto-allocate, Orks' turn, Fight phase
steps.script:
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"].models[0]["position"] = {"x": 720.0, "y": 1900.0}
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
GameState.set_active_player(2)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(10)
return true

steps.comment: re-opened for the other readied units (Blade Champion, Contemptor)
the Custodian Guard is no longer offered a ka'tah
no paid stratagem at 0 CP — normally no window
hit stage: the dock names Kaptaris as the reason for the worse hit threshold
the Boyz' melee hit roll against the Custodian Guard names Kaptaris as a -1
show the Dice Log tab (the hit roll names Kaptaris)
